description: Sidewalk Inventory is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. This data layer represents the sidewalks located along roadways for the City of Bloomington. It includes sidewalks maintained by the City of Bloomington as well as other known sidewalks. The data also contains sidewalks which do not exist, noted as "no sidewalk". Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The portal files it under the category Public Works. Its tags are sidepaths, pedestrian, maps, gis, sidewalks. The table has 18 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
